answers.core:
1. Fundamental Feature: Type safety is a core pillar of the C# ecosystem. This feature bridges the gap between C# type safety and Godot's resource system.

1. Editor Integration: Implementing this as an add-on requires complex EditorInspectorPlugin hooks that can be unstable or conflict with other plugins. Native support ensures consistent behavior across all C# projects.

1. Performance: A native implementation (C++ side checking of SceneState) is significantly faster than a managed add-on reflecting over resources every time the Inspector updates.

title: Add PackedScene<T> generic support for C# to enforce scene root node type safety
